## KiteKeep stage pull request

### Stage
- [ ] This PR belongs to exactly one declared development stage.
- Stage name:

### Required checks
- [ ] Stage acceptance criteria passed.
- [ ] Required automated tests passed.
- [ ] Evidence was added under the stage `evidence/` folder where applicable.
- [ ] `context/HANDOFF.md` was updated.
- [ ] No undeclared source areas were modified.
- [ ] No secrets, signing material, parent PINs, device serials, or machine-specific paths were committed.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes received the required security review.
- [ ] Reviewer used a different agent role from the implementation agent where practical.
- [ ] `PROJECT_STATE.yaml` matches the stage state.

### Human approval
- [ ] Explicit manual approval to merge into `main` has been given.

Do not enable automatic merge for KiteKeep stage PRs.
